title: Environment package + CDN delivery via signed URLs; unpublish; free-tier cap (AUTH #026)
summary: Package the environment (splat, collision mesh, scene graph, environment spec, thumbnail; vendor-neutral, versioned) into Supabase storage behind a CDN and deliver it only through signed URLs (≤15 min TTL) issued server-side after an auth check, with the CDN forwarding the signature. Enforce the free-tier 3-published-live cap at publish; unpublish removes from feeds immediately and frees a slot. Packages carry no location data (SPEC §3.7; security-sensitive → secondary review, AUTH #007).

acceptance_tests.test: A published package is retrievable only through a signed URL with a TTL ≤15 min issued server-side after an auth check; a direct storage URL is refused; the CDN forwards the signature.
Packages and thumbnails carry no location data and no capture metadata beyond the schema (SECURITY_CHECKLIST §4.4).
The free-tier cap (3 published live) is enforced at publish; unpublish frees a slot and removes the environment from all feeds immediately.
No storage or CDN credential appears in the repo; secrets live only in .env.local / CI.
